name: Labeled Faces in the Wild (LFW)
description: A landmark benchmark database for studying the problem of unconstrained face recognition and face verification. Developed by the Computer Vision Laboratory at the University of Massachusetts Amherst. Contains 13,233 web-collected face images of 5,749 distinct individuals, of which 1,680 people have two or more images. Serves as the quintessential academic evaluation benchmark for pair-matching face verification in natural environments.
